claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows only a partial, watermark-obscured brand text ('NEL' or similar); no model number visible anywhere.
No country-of-origin marking, nameplate, or serial tag visible in any photo.
Photos are static; no video or audio of the motor/pedal operating.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: Only scissors, bobbins, and some thread cones are visible; no manual, spare needles, or accessory case shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service record, invoice, or internal mechanism photo to support this history claim.

risks.risk: Motor/mechanism may not actually run or may run poorly
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powered on, pedal pressed, needle moving through fabric

risks.risk: True age and wear of the machine unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of serial number/nameplate and any dated manual page
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, uncertain age

risks.risk: Accessory completeness (manual, extra bobbins, needles, accessory case) unconfirmed
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories and manual laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine without extras

risks.risk: Electrical safety of cord, plug, and internal wiring
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug, cord condition, and motor wiring connections

risks.risk: Brand/model unverifiable, may not be a known/valuable make
risks.proof: Clear, unobstructed photo of the full nameplate/brand badge

risks.risk: Unclear if thread stand, foot press, and table/stand are included in the sale price
risks.proof: Seller's itemized list or photo with items separated and labeled as included
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine head only, stand/accessories excluded

proof_requests: Video of the machine running under power with pedal engaged and needle stitching fabric
Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/serial number without watermark obstruction
Photo of all included accessories and the manual laid out together
Close-up of power cord, plug, and wiring condition
Confirmation in writing of exactly what is included (stand, thread rack, foot press, table)
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an industrial sewing machine with table and stand, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified motor condition, unconfirmed brand/origin, and incomplete accessory evidence.
